sourcesNote: Trophy names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation 5 list. Every guide below is written in our own words from the official descriptions and the game's own systems; community trackers (PSNProfiles, Exophase, PowerPyx, PlayStationTrophies.org) are cited where they mirror the official list. No guide text is copied from any other guide.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do. Use the roadmap below and tick trophies off as you go; the last ones standing are usually the long grinds (250 stunts, 100 vehicles, 100% completion), so start those early and chip away between story missions.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Play through the opening mission 'Gone Fishing' — the first mission of the game — and the trophy unlocks when the mission completes. If you are replaying, it is the first mission in the mission list, so it cannot be missed on a fresh playthrough.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish every story mission in Chapter 1; the trophy pops on the chapter-complete screen. Chapters follow on from each other, so just keep playing the gold 'story' markers on the map and it will come naturally.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete all of Chapter 2's story missions. The chapter ends with a mission that wraps up the chapter's arc — finish it and the trophy unlocks. No side content is required for this one.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Play through Chapter 3 to its final mission. By this point the map is fully open, but you can ignore side activities entirely — only the chapter's story missions count toward the unlock.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish Chapter 4's story missions. This is the last numbered chapter before the finale, so once it pops you are one step from the final mission and its gold trophy.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the final story mission after Chapter 4. The game makes it obvious — it is the last gold marker — and the trophy unlocks on the mission-complete screen. After the credits you can keep playing in free roam to clean up everything else.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission 'Breakfast Run' when it appears in the story. Mission names are shown on the mission-start screen and in the pause menu's mission list, so you can check you have done it. Replaying the mission from the list also counts.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the heist mission 'The Cartel Heist'. Heist missions are long, multi-stage jobs — follow the on-screen objectives, use cover, and stock up on armour and ammo at an Ammu-Nation before you start. The trophy pops when the mission completes.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission 'Child's Play'. Like the other mission trophies, it unlocks on completion and can also be earned by replaying the mission from the pause menu afterwards.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission 'Headliners'. It is a story mission, so it appears as a gold marker when it is time; finish it and the trophy is yours.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission 'VCIA Takedown' at the airport. Expect a combat-heavy mission around the terminal — bring a rifle with plenty of ammo and use the mission's checkpoints if you go down.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission 'Operation Savage Glory'. It is one of the later story missions; follow the objectives to the end and the trophy unlocks on completion.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The completionist gold. Open the pause menu and check Stats > 100% Completion to see exactly what counts: story missions, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and the long grinds all feed into it. Work through the checklist in this guide — every trophy here moves the percentage — and use the in-game checklist as your source of truth, since it shows which categories are still open. This is the trophy that makes the platinum take time; save it for last.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: The big driving grind — 250 stunts in total. A stunt counts when the game registers a jump, near-miss, long airtime or drift chain; the cleanest farm is the airport runways and the long highway bridges, where you can hit ramps at speed, land cleanly and turn around for another run. Faster cars with good handling help, and stunts also count during missions, so a large chunk will come naturally. Check your running total in Stats so you know how far along you are; start early and do a few runs between story missions rather than leaving all 250 for the end.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: There are 9 activity types in Leonida — races, fishing, arcade games, shooting range, drone races, bowling, meditation, hunting and the Top Fun challenges are the usual set. The trophy only asks you to try each one once, not to win or finish it, so walk into each activity marker and start it. If you are unsure which ones you have done, the pause menu's activity list shows what is available; work down it and the trophy pops on the ninth type.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: There are 42 Shooting Range challenges across the ranges in Leonida. Each one grades you bronze, silver or gold on score and accuracy — gold needs tight groupings and fast target transitions, so use a rifle with a scope for the long targets and a pistol for the close ones, and reload between waves. You can retry any challenge as often as you like, and progress is per-challenge, so clear them one range at a time. The Shooting Range markers show on the map once you have visited one.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Top Fun drone races run at 14 locations around Leonida. Fly the drone through the rings in order — cutting corners loses time, and the racing line matters more than top speed. Each location has its own race; winning at a location marks it off, and the trophy pops after the fourteenth win. If a race is giving you trouble, retry it immediately — there is no penalty for retrying.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race 20 times. Races are marked on the map and in the activities list; street races, off-road and boat races all count. Pick a fast, well-handling car for road races and keep it upgraded, brake early for corners, and use slipstream on the straights. Your wins are tracked per event, so work through the list and the trophy pops on the twentieth distinct win.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Find Cal at a fishing spot and take his fishing challenge, then out-fish him. Fishing is a timing mini-game: wait for the bite, hook, then keep the tension in the green zone while reeling — too much tension snaps the line, too little lets the fish escape. Cal's challenge is a scored contest, so land the bigger catch; if you lose, challenge him again straight away.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Walk into any arcade in Leonida, pick a cabinet and finish a full game — any game counts, and you only need to complete one. Arcade cabinets are in bars and arcades around Vice City; the game ends when you win, lose or finish the run, and the trophy pops at the results screen.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Character-strand trophy. Follow Andy's mission strand — the missions appear as that character's marker on the map — through to its final mission and complete it. Strands unlock as the story progresses; if Andy's marker is not showing yet, keep playing the main story until it appears. The final mission is clearly the strand's conclusion.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Character-strand trophy. Play through Kenton's strand to its final mission. These strands are separate from the main story markers, so check the map for Kenton's marker between story missions and clear each one as it appears.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Character-strand trophy. Follow Billy's strand to its final mission and complete it. Billy's missions involve riding — a good bike and a helmet's worth of patience help — and the strand unlocks progressively through the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Strangers & Freaks strands are the question-mark encounters scattered across Leonida. Talk to each stranger, follow their mission chain to its end, and the strand counts as complete. You need 8 finished strands — there are more than 8 in the state, so you can skip ones you dislike. Some strands only appear at certain times or after story progress, so revisit areas as the story advances. This is the one stranger trophy that can bite: a strand can be failed or locked off by story choices, so if a stranger's missions stop appearing, move on to another stranger rather than assuming it will come back.
trophies.missableNote: Some stranger strands can be locked off by story progress or failed choices — finish the strands you start, and don't leave all 8 for the post-game.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Character-strand trophy. Follow Randy's strand through to its final mission. Randy's missions appear as his marker on the map as the story progresses; clear each as it shows up and the finale unlocks in turn.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Character-strand trophy. Play through Tyrone's strand to its final mission. Tyrone's strand opens up mid-story — if his marker is not on the map yet, continue the main story and check back.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: There are 18 meditation spots across Leonida — quiet overlooks, beaches and parks, each marked once you get close. Sit and meditate at each one; the game counts a spot once the meditation completes. A spot only registers when you finish the full meditation, so don't walk off halfway. Work through them region by region and the trophy pops at the eighteenth.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Part of Bret's stranger strand: Bret asks you to hunt a specific unique animal. Track it using the hunting markers — the animal's territory is shown once the hunt starts — approach quietly from downwind, and take the shot cleanly. If you spook it, it will flee and you will need to track it again. Finish the hunt and the trophy unlocks; Bret's strand can be affected by story progress, so do it when it appears rather than leaving it.
trophies.missableNote: Tied to Bret's stranger strand — do it when the hunt is offered; stranger strands can close off as the story advances.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Collectible cards are hidden all over Leonida — in shops, on rooftops, in alleyways. A set is complete when you have every card in it; you need 3 full sets. Cards glint and make a sound when you are near one, and the collection menu shows which sets you have finished and which cards are still missing. Sweep each district thoroughly, and check rooftops and interiors you would otherwise walk past.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It is the photo-spot activity: find a WAiNK location, frame the shot and take the photo. There are well over 100 locations across Leonida — landmarks, murals, viewpoints and oddities — and the game marks a location as done once the photo is accepted. The photo app shows how many you have done; the fastest route is to sweep the map district by district, since locations cluster around landmarks. You don't need every location in the game, just 100.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Challenges are the game's side objectives — stunts, kills, driving feats and more — listed in the pause menu under Challenges. Any 50 completed challenges count, across all categories, and many will complete naturally while you play. Check the list regularly and chase the easy ones (short stunt chains, simple weapon challenges) to top up the count; the trophy pops at the fiftieth.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Do this with your partner beside you (story missions with a partner, or free-roam partner activities). Build a 4-star wanted level — cause enough chaos for the helicopters to arrive — then break line of sight, get out of the search area and stay hidden until the stars clear. The partner must still be with you when the wanted level drops, so don't let them get arrested or left behind. A fast car and the highway tunnels or countryside back roads make the escape much easier.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside you, rob three shops in a row without the wanted level dropping in between. Point your weapon at the clerk, grab the cash, and move straight to the next shop — plan a route through a shopping street so the three are close together. Keep the wanted level alive by staying in the police's sight just enough; if it clears, the chain resets and you start over.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: A vehicle counts as discovered the first time you get into it (or it is added to your collection). Leonida is full of variety — cars, bikes, boats, planes and more — so just drive everything you see. Car parks, dealerships, the docks and the airport are the richest hunting grounds, and the vehicle list in the pause menu shows what you have found. 100 sounds like a lot, but it comes fast if you hop into a new vehicle whenever you pass one.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is the slow-motion aiming mode. Trigger it in a firefight with at least five enemies in front of you — a gang hideout or a police ambush works well — and drop all five before the meter runs out. Headshots help, and a rifle or SMG with a large magazine means no reload mid-run. If you run out of enemies, let the meter refill and try again; the count is per single use, so all five must fall in one activation.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Head to Vice City International Airport (VCIA) and leave in a way the airport did not schedule — steal a plane and take off without clearance. Get onto the tarmac, climb into any parked aircraft, and get airborne. The police will respond, so take off quickly and climb away from the airport; the trophy pops once you are in the air and clear.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: The Rhino is the military tank. Get a 4- or 5-star wanted level and Rhinos will roll in as part of the response — or find one at the military base. The trophy is about dealing with them: destroy or hijack one. A Rhino's armour shrugs off small arms, so use explosives, sticky bombs or a heavy weapon, and keep moving so its cannon can't track you.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: A stealth robbery: get into a jewelry store, take the goods and get out without any alarm or witness raising the alarm. Go at night, avoid the cameras' cones, take out the guard quietly if you must, and leave before anyone notices. If you are spotted, the attempt fails — leave the area, let the heat die down and try again.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Bank vaults are the big robberies: five of them, each a set-piece job. Vault locations are found through the game's robbery leads — check your phone and the map for bank targets. Each vault needs a plan (crew, entry, getaway), so stock up first, then rob the vault and escape the police response to bank the job. Five successful vault jobs and the trophy is yours.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida — watch for them on the roads, especially near banks and commercial districts. Stop the truck (ram it or block it), crack it open, take the cash and lose the police. Explosives open the rear doors fastest; once the money is yours, break line of sight and escape the search area.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: There are 52 named areas in Leonida, from Vice City's districts to the swamps and the Keys. An area counts once you have set foot (or driven) into it. The map greys out unexplored areas, so sweep the map systematically — coast roads, the islands and the rural north are the ones people miss. The trophy pops the moment the last area is revealed.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Each of the 9 gangs runs illegal operations — stash houses, labs, chop shops — marked when you scout them. Rob one operation per gang: hit the site, take the goods and get out. Gang territory is shown on the map, and the operations appear as targets once you are in the area. Nine gangs, nine robberies, and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to Ocean Beach, find a beach bar with a view of the water, and order a cocktail. Sit, drink, enjoy the view — the trophy pops when the drink is served. It's a free-roam moment, so you can do it any time after the area is open.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Find a vehicle showroom, get into one of the display cars and drive it straight out through the glass — the classic GTA showroom exit. Any showroom works; pick a fast car on the floor, aim for the front windows and floor it. The trophy pops once you are out on the street with the car.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and play a full game of bowling — follow through on the lane. Bowling is one of the 9 activities; a full game means all frames. The trophy pops at the end of the game regardless of your score.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A story-moment trophy tied to a partnership scene — it unlocks during a mission where you and your partner pull off something that gets the public's attention. It is a one-off story beat, so if you are chasing the platinum in one run, keep a manual save before the later story missions: if the moment passes, mission replay from the pause menu is the way back.
trophies.missableNote: A one-off story moment — keep a manual save before the later story missions, and use mission replay if it passes you by.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: A cumulative-count trophy: the game tracks choices you make across the story — dialogue options, mission decisions and side-content picks. Keep playing and making choices and the counter climbs; the community trackers put the count at 500 choices. There is no way to grind it directly, so just play the story and side content thoroughly — it will pop on its own before the end of a full playthrough.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: A second-attempt trophy: fail something, then succeed on the retry. The cleanest way is a mission or challenge you can fail and immediately retry — go in, fail the objective on purpose, then complete it on the second attempt. The trophy pops when the retry succeeds. It is tied to a specific retry moment in the game, so if it does not pop from a casual retry, look for a mission with a clear fail state and repeat it.
trophies.missableNote: Tied to a retry moment — if it doesn't pop from casual retries, use a mission with a clear fail state and succeed on the second attempt.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: A 'witness something strange' trophy — Leonida has random odd encounters (a UFO sighting, a cryptid in the swamps, a strange event on the coast). These are random free-roam events, so explore the odd corners of the map — the swamps at night, the desert roads, the ocean — and keep an eye out. It can happen at any time in free roam, so there is no rush, but it is random, so it may take a while to trigger.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: A drive-by with a melee weapon: get in a car with a passenger (or drive slowly past a pedestrian), equip a melee weapon, and strike someone from the moving car so they go down like a bowling pin. Low speed and a straight run help with the aim. Do it in a quiet street so the police response stays small.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked Bills are the dirty cash from robberies and heists. Launder them through your contacts — the laundering options appear in your phone/contacts once you have marked bills to clean. Each laundering run converts a chunk; repeat until $250,000 has been cleaned in total. Robberies are the fastest source of marked bills, so this pairs naturally with the bank-vault and armored-truck trophies.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops — clothes, weapons, car mods, food, anything with a price tag. The counter is cumulative across every shop in the game, so it climbs naturally as you gear up; if you are close, a round of weapon upgrades or a car makeover will finish it. Check your spending total in Stats if you want to see how far along you are.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: There are 8 garage properties to buy across Leonida. Property markers appear on the map (and in the in-game property listings) once you have the cash — garages are the cheaper properties, so save up and buy them as they appear. Owning all 8 pops the trophy; garages also give you somewhere to store the rare vehicles you find for the 100-vehicle trophy.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app lets you register vehicles you own. Open the app on your phone, pick a vehicle from your collection and register it — repeat for 10 different vehicles. Any 10 count, so use the cars already in your garages. The app is available once you have a phone and a garage, early in the game.
trophies.name: On the Spot
